sentences.en: The pilot explained to us why the landing was delayed.
sentences.zh: 飞行员向我们解释了为什么降落被推迟。

sentences.en: It was next to impossible to get a trained pilot.
sentences.zh: 很难找到一个合格的飞行员。

sentences.en: I want to be a pilot when I grow up.
sentences.zh: 等我长大了，我想成为一名飞行员。
